newsitem.title: GERMANY: SOCCER-LEVERKUSEN FACE RIDICULE IF BEATEN - COACH.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-LEVERKUSEN FACE RIDICULE IF BEATEN - COACH.

text.p: Bayer Leverkusen coach Christoph Daum has warned his players they will be the laughing stock of German soccer if they fail to beat Dynamo Tbilisi on Wednesday.
The master-motivator said his players must improve on recent league performances if they are to defeat the Georgian champions in the home first leg of their European Cup preliminary round clash.
Daum, who transformed Leverkusen from no-hopers to Bundesliga runners-up in his first season in charge, believes Wednesday's match is vital for the future of the club.
"Last season's work was worth nothing if we don't get past the Georgians," he said.
"The players can write footballing history by reaching the Champions' League. But if we don't knock out Tblisi, the whole of German football will be making fun of us."
However, despite his warnings of ridicule, the former Stuttgart coach is taking his opponents seriously.
"Tblisi are a young and ambitious team who play well. This will be anything but a stroll," he said. "There's absolutely no call for arrogance."
Daum has watched the Georgians in action twice and prepared video cassettes on each individual player. He also held a closed-door training session on Monday night.
"We've had guests from Tblisi as observers all the time over the last few days," he said. "They don't have to know everything."

Leverkusen, who have never won the German championship, are in the European Cup for the first time and would dearly like to make it a hat-trick of German sides in the Champions' League alongside last year's winners Borussia Dortmund and Bundesliga champions Bayern Munich.

"The Champions' League would be worth its weight in gold for us, from a sporting, financial and image point of view," general manager Reiner Calmund said. "It would be the absolute highlight of the club's history."
Leverkusen - Dirk Heinen, Jens Nowotny, Christian Woerns, Markus Happe, Hans-Peter Lehnhoff, Emerson, Carsten Ramelow, Stefan Beinlich, Jan Heintze, Ulf Kirsten, Eric Meijer.

Tiblisi (from) - Irakly Zoidze, Gela Chanturia, Kakhi Kaladze, Zviad Djeladze, Givi Didava, Nugzar Lobjanidze, Alexander Gogoberishvili, Valter Guchua, Gia Chkhaidze, George Kiknadze, Kakhi Gogichaishvili, Rati Aleksidze, David Mudjiri, Alexander Iashvili, Givi Kvaratskhelia, George Davitnidze, Levan Khomeriki.
